title: Journey
subtitle: Where your calling operation stands, and the highest-leverage thing to do next.

error.title: We could not load your journey right now
error.body: This is only the summary — your calls, contacts and campaigns are unaffected. Refresh in a moment, or jump straight into your work.

empty.title: Your journey starts with one conversation
empty.body: Get a number, add a few contacts and make your first call. Everything else on this page unlocks from there.

paused.title: The Journey is paused
paused.body: Your progress is safe and keeps being recorded. Rewards will be available again shortly.

status.optionalHint: A bonus step. You do not need it to finish this track.

completion.heading: Journey progress
completion.explainer: There is more than one way to finish. Complete Core Calling, then any {count} tracks that match how you actually sell — the ones you skip are not missing progress, they are simply not your path.
completion.doneBody: Core Calling plus {count} tracks. Your workspace is using Ringee about as fully as it gets — keep an eye on connect rates and cost from the dashboard.

core.name: Core Calling
core.description: Get set up, build a calling rhythm and log what happened. Everything else builds on this.

team.name: Team
team.description: Get more than one person genuinely calling, not just invited.

campaigns.name: Campaigns
campaigns.description: Turn ad-hoc dialing into a repeatable outbound process.

integrations.name: Integrations
integrations.description: Make calls, meetings and outcomes flow into the rest of your stack — using whichever tools you already work in.

ai.name: AI
ai.description: Let AI read your calls and turn them into something you can act on.

automation.name: Automation
automation.description: Hand the repetitive work to Ringee, in whichever way suits your operation.

inbound.name: Inbound
inbound.description: Handle the calls that come to you. Entirely optional — nothing else in the Journey depends on it.

graph.heading: Your map
graph.hint: Click a track to see every step it takes — and what it pays.

hub.aria: {name} — {percent}% of the journey complete. Every track starts here.

capabilities.heading: What you are using
capabilities.hint: A capability counts once it has produced real results — not when it is switched on.

counts.heading: What counts
counts.body: Progress is measured from real activity in this workspace: calls that were answered and lasted long enough to be a conversation, integrations that actually moved data, and AI that produced a result you can act on.
counts.doesNotCount: Turning a setting on, connecting an account, or inviting someone does not count on its own.
counts.workspaceScope: The Journey belongs to the whole workspace, not to one person.

setup.name: Ready to dial
setup.promise: Verify your phone and get a number you can call from.
setup.value: Everything else in Ringee builds on one working number and a verified account.

first_call.name: First conversation
first_call.value: One answered call proves your whole setup end to end — audio, routing and billing.

rhythm.name: Calling rhythm
rhythm.promise: Turn calling into a routine rather than a burst.
rhythm.value: Spreading calls across days and contacts is what makes outbound predictable instead of lucky.

discipline.name: Outcome discipline
discipline.promise: Log what happened on the calls that mattered.
discipline.value: Outcomes are what turn a call list into a pipeline you can forecast and coach against.

scale.name: Sustained volume
scale.promise: Keep it going across weeks, not days.
scale.value: Sustained volume is the difference between a good week and an operation that holds up.

joined.name: Team on board
joined.value: Shared numbers, analytics and coaching only start paying off once more than one person is in.

calling.name: Team calling
calling.promise: Get more than one person genuinely on the phone.
calling.value: A team that calls together is where shared caller IDs and comparative analytics start to matter.

coverage.name: Coverage
coverage.promise: Keep several people calling, week after week.
coverage.value: Coverage is what keeps your pipeline moving when one person is on holiday or having a bad week.

first.name: First campaign
first.promise: Run a real outbound campaign end to end.
first.value: Campaigns turn ad-hoc dialing into a repeatable process with leads, attempts and outcomes you can measure.

pipeline.name: Leads worked properly
pipeline.promise: Reach the leads in your list and record what happened.
pipeline.value: A campaign you cannot measure is a call list. Worked leads and logged outcomes are what make it a process.

repeatable.name: Repeatable machine
repeatable.value: The second campaign is where the process proves itself — and where your first one's data starts paying off.

crm.name: CRM sync
crm.promise: Get your calls landing in your CRM automatically.
crm.value: When outcomes reach your CRM without anyone re-typing them, nothing falls through and your pipeline reflects reality.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.promise: Push booked meetings to a real calendar.
calendar.value: A meeting that is not on a calendar is a meeting that does not happen.

enrichment.name: Lead enrichment
enrichment.promise: Turn prospect searches into contacts you can call.
enrichment.value: Enrichment is what keeps the top of your list full without anyone building it by hand.

custom.name: Custom integration
custom.promise: Send call events to your own systems.
custom.value: Your stack is not everyone's stack. Webhooks are how Ringee fits the one you already have.

connected.name: Connected operation
connected.promise: Get data flowing at real volume.
connected.value: Any mix of CRM, calendar and custom integrations counts — what matters is that the data actually moves.

transcription.name: Calls transcribed
transcription.promise: Turn your calls into text AI can read.
transcription.value: Transcripts are the raw material for everything else AI can tell you about your calling.

insights.name: AI insights
insights.promise: Let AI produce something you can act on.
insights.value: Objection patterns and follow-up recommendations turn every call into practice for the next one.

team_adoption.name: AI across the team
team_adoption.promise: Put AI to work for more than one rep.
team_adoption.value: Patterns are far more useful across a team than for one person — that is where coaching comes from.

callbacks.name: Callbacks worked
callbacks.promise: Actually call back the people you promised to.
callbacks.value: Scheduling a callback is free. Working it is where the deals are.

rotation.name: Caller ID rotation
rotation.promise: Let Ringee pick the right number to call from.
rotation.value: Local presence and healthy numbers lift answer rates without anyone managing a spreadsheet.

sessions.name: Call sessions
sessions.promise: Hand someone a dialing queue with one link.
sessions.value: Sessions are how you get a contractor or a colleague calling in minutes, with no account setup.

agents.name: Agent-driven calling
agents.promise: Let an agent queue the calls and file the outcomes.
agents.value: Agents take the legwork, so your time goes to conversations only you can have.

breadth.name: Multi-capability operation
breadth.promise: Get three advanced capabilities genuinely working.
breadth.value: Which three is up to you — breadth is what keeps answer rates and cost under control as you scale.

routing.name: Inbound answered
routing.promise: Route incoming calls somewhere they get picked up.
routing.value: A number people can call back is worth more than a number that only dials out.

desk_phones.name: Desk phones
desk_phones.promise: Take inbound calls on real handsets.
desk_phones.value: Desk phones are how an office floor answers without everyone living in a browser tab.

recovery.name: Missed calls recovered
recovery.promise: Call back the people you missed.
recovery.value: A missed call you return within a day is a lead. One you never return is a competitor's lead.

requirement.dialable_number: Have a number or verified caller ID
requirement.inbound_sip_calls: Inbound calls on a desk phone

core.rhythm: Calls count once they are answered and last long enough to be a conversation — short misdials do not.
core.discipline: You can log an outcome straight from the call screen, or later from Activities.

integrations.connected: Any mix counts: CRM syncs, calendar meetings and custom webhook deliveries all add up.

automation.breadth: Any three capabilities count. Pick the ones that match how you sell — there is no required set.

inbound.routing: Inbound is entirely optional. Nothing else in the Journey waits on it.

ai.transcription: Transcription is set per workspace, and applies to calls recorded from then on.

a11y.keyboardHint: Use the arrow keys to move between the tracks on the map.

thread.electiveHint: This track is a choice, not a gap. Skipping it costs you nothing — finish Core Calling plus the tracks that match how you actually sell.
